cohort: Pregnant women with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 undergoing operative delivery at the Royal Free Hospital, one of four High Consequence Infectious Disease centres in England
finding: A simulation study evaluating a standard operating procedure for suspected and confirmed COVID-19 women undergoing operative delivery identified a number of operational deficiencies, mainly related to lack of situational awareness, ill-fitting personal protective equipment and difficulties communicating between theatre and the neonatal teams.
